U.S. September CPI Broadly Exceeds Expectations, Annual Rate Rises to 3.7%, Highest Since May U.S. September headline CPI rose 3.7% year over year, the highest since May, exceeding market expectations of 3.6%. Month over month, unadjusted CPI increased 0.6%, the highest since April. Core CPI rose 2.6% year over year, the highest since June, above expectations of 2.5%. Seasonally adjusted core CPI increased 0.3% month over month, above expectations of 0.2%. — link

Polygon Completes Coinme Acquisition, Turns Open Money Stack Into US-Regulated Payments Platform Polygon Labs has completed its acquisition of Coinme, integrating regulated U.S. money transfer services into the Polygon Open Money Stack. The platform now covers 48 U.S. states, holding 37 state-level money transmitter licenses and 11 applicable exemptions, and is registered with FinCEN as a money services business. Tazapay, Mesh, Toku and Kira are the first customers, using it for cross-border business payments, account top-ups, global payroll and USD services. — link

Bastion Trading Demands SkyAI Improve Tender Offer, Questions 70% Disposal of SOL Holdings and Calls for Board Reconstitution According to Bastion Trading, Solana treasury company SkyAI sold approximately 70% of its SOL holdings in less than a month, leaving around 600,000 SOL, without adequately disclosing the timing, prices or approval process. Bastion and its affiliates, which hold approximately 9.99% of SkyAI, are calling for full disclosure of the sales, a board overhaul and an increase in the proposed cash tender offer price from $3.00 to at least $3.50 per share or eligible warrant, while excluding management and related parties from participating. — link

Former FTX Europe Head’s Perpetuals com Files to Trade Tokenized U.S. Stocks Under SEC Innovation Exemption Nasdaq-listed Perpetuals com, led by former FTX Europe head Patrick Gruhn, has filed with the SEC to operate a tokenized securities venue under the five-year Innovation Exemption. It is the second firm to pursue U.S. tokenized stock trading under the framework, after the OKX-ICE joint venture. Tokens must carry the same dividend and voting rights as ordinary shares, and companies have 30 days to object. Trading is planned via permissioned AMM pools on its Ethereum-compatible L2 Kronos X Public, with USDC as the settlement asset. A launch could come as early as mid-November. — link
